summary: Condonation of delay in second appeal under Limitation Act s.5; State's claim of sufficient cause due to review petition delay followed by pandemic circumstances; court examined balance between technical compliance with limitation and access to merits; precedent establishes government not entitled to leniency exceeding that of ordinary litigants; no plausible sufficient cause shown given prior delay was already penalized in review petition dismissal; pandemic timing did not cover entire delay period; dismissal of state's second appeal upheld.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court's condonation of delay set aside; second appeal dismissed.
